# cg api test-session

The `test-session` service endpoint. See [`cg api`](index.md) for how these relate to the higher-level commands.

| Command | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`cg api test-session`](#cg-api-test-session) | TestSession service commands. |
| [`cg api test-session start-test-session`](#cg-api-test-session-start-test-session) | Start (or resume) an interactive IDE test session for a puzzle. |
| [`cg api test-session play`](#cg-api-test-session-play) | Run a codingamer's code against a single test case within a test session. |
| [`cg api test-session generate-lsp-token`](#cg-api-test-session-generate-lsp-token) | Generate a Language Server Protocol (LSP) auth token for a test session. |
| [`cg api test-session get-previous-code-by-language-id`](#cg-api-test-session-get-previous-code-by-language-id) | Fetch the codingamer's most recently saved code for one language in a test session. |
| [`cg api test-session submit`](#cg-api-test-session-submit) | Submit a final solution to a puzzle for credit. |

## `cg api test-session get-previous-code-by-language-id`

```text
[1;34musage: [0m[1;35mcg api test-session get-previous-code-by-language-id[0m [[32m-h[0m] [32mTEST-SESSION-HANDLE[0m [32mLANGUAGE-ID[0m

Fetch the codingamer's most recently saved code for one language in a test session. CodinGame
keeps your latest source per language, not just one; this reaches the ones the session isn't
currently on. Prints JSON null if you've never attempted the puzzle in that language. This is a
pure read--it does NOT make that language the session's current one (only running a test or
submitting does that).

[1;34mpositional arguments:[0m
  [1;32mTEST-SESSION-HANDLE[0m  The puzzle's test session handle.
  [1;32mLANGUAGE-ID[0m          CodinGame language ID, e.g. 'Python3', 'C++'.

[1;34moptions:[0m
  [1;32m-h[0m, [1;36m--help[0m           show this help message and exit
```
